requiredBehaviors.behavior: Level 2 NOT_RUN oder FAIL setzen und den fehlenden sicheren Adapter konkret melden
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Level-2 template model requires a safe insertion adapter/profile; the error-handling contract keeps Level 2 at NOT_RUN/FAIL when that adapter is missing or unsafe.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: das bereitgestellte kontrollierte Template unverändert lassen
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly forbids destructive modification of the controlled binary template and separates the binary source from the adapter/profile.

forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The template contract explicitly prohibits silent fallback when a controlled template was supplied but cannot be processed safely.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: an beliebiger Position in das kontrollierte Template schreiben
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Level 2 requires an explicit safe body insertion point such as a content control, bookmark or anchor before authoring.
